findings.text: follow-on: stage_command returns commands[stage.domain], so all three signals stages (domain "signals") resolve to the bare signals command and the recorded stage.command flags are ignored — a non-dry run would invoke "discover signals" three times without --scan-only/--enrich-only (imas_codex/cli/discover/signals.py:61) and never run the scan/enrich/check split the registry documents.

follow-on: the mapping stage records model_section="mapping", which is not a key of settings.MODEL_SECTIONS (imas_codex/settings.py:141 lists "ids-mapping"); a consumer calling settings.get_model(stage.model_section) raises ValueError, so the recorded seat is unusable and inconsistent with the candidates stage's valid "mapping-candidates".

follow-on: _wiki_target returns the first configured wiki_site only, so the wiki stage's access probe tests one site's reachability while §2 requires "each site reachable"; with a second site down the stage still reads runnable.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is §2 of facility-discovery-sequence — one ordered stage registry in imas_codex/cli/discover/sequence.py with each stage's access need, config keys, input stages and pending-work predicate, plus access probes reusing the canonical checks and a dry run; the landed STAGES tuple holds the nine stages in exactly the plan's table order (paths, code, documents, wiki, signals scan, signals enrich, signals check, candidates, mapping), each domain from DISCOVERY_DOMAINS is owned by a stage and mapping records domain None, so the goal is met.

item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares imas_codex/cli/discover/sequence.py, imas_codex/cli/discover/__init__.py, imas_codex/discovery/documents/pipeline.py, tests/cli/test_discover_sequence.py and tests/discovery/; the diff adds six files all inside them, and nothing outside was touched.

justifications.durability: tests/cli/test_discover_sequence.py:137 patches the pending predicates True then False and asserts the outcome follows, and the raising-query tests genuinely redden under the recorded negative control, but no test covers the non-dry run_sequence invocation loop (sequence.py:398), so the signals-mode mis-dispatch and the invalid mapping seat pass the whole suite.
justifications.evidence: the gate command in imas_codex/cli/discover/sequence.py's own test file measures the done-when and its result is recorded (69 passed, exit 0) in the manifest and in pytest-gate.log, and the negative control is recorded red with two failing ids, but the gate log carries no revision/tree/command header so it is not self-binding to 21c0e6d34 and is tied only through the manifest's word.
justifications.fit: the module follows the repo idiom (frozen dataclass, click command, module docstring) and its names carry no plan label, but the mapping stage's model_section "mapping" (sequence.py:202) is not a key of MODEL_SECTIONS (imas_codex/settings.py:141), which the repo's own seat owner rejects.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/cli/discover/sequence.py:112 builds STAGES in the plan's nine-stage table order with domain None for mapping, but the extra model_section field carries an invalid seat (see findings) and the non-dry invocation path mis-dispatches the signals stages.
justifications.reuse: sequence.py:33 imports neo4j_health_check, ssh_health_check and wiki_auth_check unchanged and imas_codex/discovery/documents/pipeline.py:91 has_pending_work extends the pipeline that owns those private checks; a search of imas_codex found no existing stage-sequence owner, so no capability was forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: all six files the commit adds lie inside the manifest's declared write paths and no path outside them changed.
